name: Pi Light
tagline: MotionCraft's pi-v2: cool white glows, ink type, one blue, words rising out of blur exactly when spoken.

motion.direction: MotionCraft `pi-v2`. Headline words rise out of blur (10 px, 0.28 em rise, 12 frames, stagger 4–5 frames, spring d11 / s140) exactly when spoken — two frames early, "eyes lead ears"; one accent word per sentence in blue `ter` (colour, never another font); h0 120–150 px, h1 64–76, ≤ 2 lines × 7 words, no all-caps sentences, tabular figures. Cards rise 180 px with 12° rotateX and 12 px blur, radius 22; pills radius 999; scenes overlap 17 frames with a blur-crossfade — never a hard cut; camera drift 8 px, zoom ≤ 1.2. Hold 0.8 s + 0.25 s per word; ≥ 1.5 s between transitions. Two soft background glows, no grain.
